articles.summary: 24/7 Wall St.: Mizuho Upgrades CrowdStrike With a $520 Price Target: Is AI Security the Next Mega-Trade?. An analyst firm just put its stamp of approval on cybersecurity leader CrowdStrike (NASDAQ:CRWD). Mizuho upgraded CRWD stock to Outperform from Neutral and lifted its price target to $520 from $490, citing improving channel checks and the company’s pole position in AI security.
